items.title: Lamar Jackson: 'Real chance' at Week 6 return
items.description:
Jackson (ankle), who has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons, has a "real chance" to return to action next week against Cleveland, pending how he responds to rehab, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
